title: Vending Machine: Coin Denominations and Exact Change
description: Handle coin inventory, compute exact change, and support card payments.

data.text: Extend the vending machine to track coin inventory, compute exact change using available coins, and fall back to card payments when exact change is impossible.

data.title: CoinInventory and ChangeMaker
Why greedy change-making works here
data.text: Standard coin systems (USD, EUR) are canonical: greedy largest-first always gives optimal coin count. For arbitrary coin sets, use dynamic programming. Vending machines almost always use canonical denominations.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Track coin inventory to know if exact change is possible
Greedy largest-first works for canonical coin systems
Card payment is a fallback when coins are exhausted
Separate CoinInventory so VendingMachine stays focused
data.takeaway: Exact change is a coin inventory problem. CoinInventory is a reusable component that knows about denominations, counts, and the change-making algorithm.
